result.summary: Refactors PSBT unknown-field coverage in the functional test suite (rpc_psbt.py). Extracts unknown-field pass-through testing into a dedicated helper and consolidates PSBT merging test cases into test_combinepsbt_preserves_unknown_fields.
result.problem: PSBT unknown-field merge tests contained redundant checks spread across unrelated test sections. Mutation testing revealed that breaking PSBT input unknown-field merging caused an unrelated pass-through test to fail rather than the intended PSBT combination test.
evidence: Author note: mutating line 434 of psbt.cpp (PSBTInput::Merge) unexpectedly broke 'Test that unknown values are just passed through' rather than the dedicated merge tests due to redundant coverage.
result.scope_notes: Small test refactoring in test/functional/rpc_psbt.py (+25/-24 lines).
result.card: Deduplicates and reorganizes PSBT unknown-field test coverage in test/functional/rpc_psbt.py. Redundant test logic meant that mutation testing on PSBTInput::Merge triggered failures in unrelated pass-through test cases instead of the dedicated merge tests. It splits pass-through testing into its own helper and folds merge assertions into test_combinepsbt_preserves_unknown_fields.

risk.why: Only modifies functional test logic in rpc_psbt.py.
